verdict.rationale: The CLI docs imply a separate pre-production stage: you "ship your auth to production from the CLI" after setting up locally. Webhook deliveries can also be relayed to a local handler and verified offline, which supports local testing. Nothing explicitly documents an isolated sandbox or development instance whose data is kept apart from production. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a sandbox/development instance with data isolated from production, test credentials or test-mode users, agent-driven sandbox workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
